text:
Anna Reynolds: Quick CTB scheduler tilt experiments across APAC/EU, running on H100 and A100 pools. baseline: window_ms=20, max_batch_tokens=4096, fairness=balanced. results below.
Kevin Liu: Nice. Can you paste the raw numbers? p50/p95 and tokens/sec please.
Anna Reynolds: H100 APAC: p50=28ms p95=115ms throughput=430k tok/s. H100 EU: p50=34ms p95=140ms throughput=380k tok/s. A100 APAC: p50=45ms p95=220ms throughput=210k tok/s. A100 EU: p50=52ms p95=260ms throughput=180k tok/s.
Marta S.: big gap EU vs APAC on H100 — suspect kernel selection + NVLink topology. any kernel flags used?
Anna Reynolds: used default kernel picker (flash-attn v2 preferred on H100). ran one sweep forcing triton kernels: H100 APAC p95 went to 130ms (worse), throughput -7%. so flash-attn still wins for our seq dist.
Riyad Khan: what about scheduler tilt? did you try biasing by region to improve fairness across tenants?
Anna Reynolds: yes. tilt config: {"tilt_mode":"weighted","weights":{"APAC":0.9,"EU":1.1}} resulted in EU p95 drop from 140ms -> 125ms but APAC p95 increased 115ms -> 135ms. overall token fairness improved (stddev of throughput across regions from 0.23 -> 0.12).
Kevin Liu: can you share the exact config snippet? put in ops-configs S3.
Anna Reynolds: pasted to s3://redwood-ctb-results/1805/tilt-config.json and linked grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ctb/tilt-sweep?var=run=1805123456
perf-bot: Benchmark run recorded: id=run-1805123456, artifacts=s3://redwood-ctb-results/1805/
Marta S.: also ran quantized model (int8) on A100 with same scheduler. latency p95 improved by ~8% but some quality regressions on long-form prompts. logging eval failures to /evals/regressions/1805-tilt.json
Riyad Khan: important: when max_batch_tokens lowered to 2048 (window_ms kept at 20) APAC H100 p50 decreased to 24ms but throughput fell 12%. tradeoff looks good for latency SLO customers.
Kevin Liu: summary for docs: recommend H100 + flash-attn for APAC low-latency tier; use tilt_weights to pull up EU fairness; expose max_batch_tokens knob per-tenant. can you add a short runbook for on-call?
Anna Reynolds: will add runbook under eng-ml/wiki: CTB Scheduler Tilt runbook + config examples. action items:
- Anna: publish runbook + config (due EOD)
- Kevin: sync with infra to ensure kernel picker telemetry (tomorrow)
- Marta: follow up on quantization evals (end of week)
Riyad Khan: thanks, looks actionable. :thumbsup:
Kevin Liu: one more note: ensure we capture per-route cold-starts in future runs (seen spikes at start of batcher pool scale-up).
